hooks.name: run-related-spec-on-save
hooks.description: Run the unit suite whenever lib/ changes

hooks.name: protect-tests-during-apply
hooks.description: Block agent writes to spec/, features/, this hook and its script unless the user has created tmp/allow-test-edits (user-only; every decision is logged to tmp/guard.log)

action.command: bundle exec rspec && bundle exec cucumber && openspec validate --all --strict --no-interactive
